changelog: **Bug-report replay player readable in dark mode, with size and download (#3131):** rrweb-player paints its controller white but inherits the text colour, so in dark mode the speed buttons, "skip inactive" and the time labels were white on white — the player's host now pins a dark text colour inline (a utility class would be flipped by the dark-mode overrides). Under the player: duration, event count and compressed size, and a "Download recording (.json.gz)" link with a note that it is an rrweb recording, not a video file.

en: The bug-report recording player now shows all its controls in dark mode, plus the recording's length and size and a download link.
tr: Hata bildirimi kayıt oynatıcısı artık karanlık modda tüm kontrollerini gösteriyor; ayrıca kaydın süresi, boyutu ve bir indirme bağlantısı var.
de: Der Player für Fehlermeldungs-Aufzeichnungen zeigt im Dunkelmodus jetzt alle Bedienelemente, dazu Länge und Größe der Aufzeichnung und einen Download-Link.
